title: Create Small Cannons
description: Makes Create Big Cannons: Modern Warfare medium cannons thinner and therefore a bit more realistic and good looking.
body: Makes the mediumcannons from Create Big Cannons: Modern Warfare thinner so they looks more realistic and beautiful. Barrels are now more elegantly proportioned to the tanks and not so bulky looking. With this texturepack you can build your vehicles closer to the real size not worrying about huge cannon in little turret.
